content.user_title: Compare Google Shopping Prices and Deals
content.value_statement: Comparing product prices across merchants requires consistent listing data. This skill submits searches to an Apify Actor and returns structured results for comparison.
actual_capabilities: Submit bundled example input, a selected JSON input file, or inline JSON to the synchronous Apify endpoint using Node.js.
Configure keyword search, product lookup, deals, or category browsing through the supplied Actor input schema.
Choose among 48 country settings and configure language, price, rating, merchant, condition, sale, and shipping filters.
Request optional product details and price history where the remote Actor and Google expose them.
Print returned dataset rows as formatted JSON, with declared fields for prices, currencies, merchants, ratings, and delivery information.
Follow documented curl examples to start asynchronous runs, check run status, and retrieve dataset items.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, network access, and paid Actor usage; the Node runner requires Node.js 18 or later.
The remote Actor performs collection; its implementation and live behavior are not included in the supplied files.
Listing completeness, filters, shipping details, and price history depend on data exposed by Google and the remote Actor.
The runner returns JSON only; it provides no built-in scheduling, price alerts, historical storage, or CSV conversion.

use_cases.title: Compare Purchase Options
use_cases.description: Collect public listings for a specific product and compare available prices, merchants, ratings, and delivery information.

use_cases.title: Research Competitor Listings
use_cases.description: Search selected product keywords in a chosen market and review public merchant prices and observed discounts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Recurring Price Exports
use_cases.description: Use repeatable search inputs for dataset exports that an external scheduling or reporting workflow can process.

prompt_templates.title: Find Product Listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 Google Shopping listings for [product] in [country]. Show available prices, currencies, merchants, ratings, and delivery details.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Discounted Offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [product] in [country] with sale and free-shipping filters, maximum price [amount], and minimum rating [rating]. Sort collected results by price.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Product Offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up [Google Shopping product ID or viewer URL] in product mode. Request price history and compare available seller offers, shipping, and currencies.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Asynchronous Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a multi-query export for [keywords] in [country] with [limit] results per query. Confirm expected costs before starting an asynchronous Apify run.

best_practices: Start with 25 or fewer results and confirm Apify pricing before expanding the search.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only public search inputs, without cookies, sessions, or private account data.
Compare matching product variants and actual currencies, then verify shipping and final prices with the merchant.
anti_patterns: Submitting private files, credentials, cookies, or account data as Actor input.
Treating sampled listings as an exhaustive market survey or guaranteed lowest checkout price.
Assuming this runner includes continuous monitoring, automatic alerts, or complete historical prices.

faq.question: What do I need before running this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, and network access. The Node runner requires Node.js 18 or later; curl examples are also supplied.

faq.question: Is the service free?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the Actor Pricing tab before running searches or increasing result limits.

faq.question: Which countries and search modes are available?
faq.answer: The supplied schema lists 48 country settings and four modes: keyword search, product lookup, deals, and category browsing.

faq.question: Can it return shipping details and price history?
faq.answer: Those fields are declared, and price history can be requested. Availability depends on what Google exposes and what the remote Actor returns.

faq.question: Does it provide CSV files or automatic price alerts?
faq.answer: The runner prints JSON. CSV conversion, scheduling, persistent storage, and alerts require an external workflow.

faq.question: Where are search inputs processed?
faq.answer: The runner sends selected JSON input to the hosted Apify Actor. Do not include private files, cookies, sessions, or account data.
